remarks: This is the unit you've been waiting for! Completely remodeled penthouse one-bedroom unit on the 17th floor of a full-service building in the heart of Stamford. Convenient to everything: shops, restaurants, mall, parks, train, waterfront, UCONN, etc. Loaded with sunlight, with Stamford, New York & Long Island Sound views! This is your luxury, chic oasis in the sky. Almost everything in the unit is newer--recessed lighting, crown molding, laminate/vinyl flooring throughout, renovated kitchen with quartz countertops & stainless steel appliances (including brand new dishwasher!), & roomy breakfast bar. Full bath with modern fixtures, large tub/shower, updated lighting & newer flooring. Open Living Room/Dining/Office floor plan. Large bedroom with recessed lighting & walk-in closet with closet system. Central Air completes this amazing unit. Just move right in! The Biltmore is a luxury hi-rise offering a 24 hour concierge, state of the art fitness center, shared outdoor green space on the 4th floor, laundry facilities, free shuttle to the Stamford Transit Hub, on-site parking garage managed by pro-park, package concierge, and community room. No additional amenity cost for gym, shuttle, community room. Small pet considered at Landlord's discretion. This is Stamford city living at it's best!
